facts.fact: In a reply dated 23 October 2025 to a parliamentary question, the higher education minister, speaking for the Prime Minister, said work is under way on a comprehensive legal framework setting the rules and policies for AI use across all sectors; no enacted text is reported.
Digital Policy Alert states Algeria has not yet adopted laws or regulations specifically governing the development and use of AI.
The National People's Assembly's secretary general says a bill by a group of deputies to regulate the development and use of AI was recently registered and would be examined by the Assembly bureau.
